source.microdata: National Center for Health Statistics. Mortality Multiple Cause-of-Death public use file, 2023 (US file). Hyattsville, MD: NCHS.
source.record_layout: NCHS. 2023 Documentation, Mortality Multiple Cause-of-Death Public Use Record.
source.control_totals: NCHS. Multiple Cause of Death Mortality File, Control Total Table 1: number of resident deaths by ICD-10 category, United States, 2023 (dated 02JUN26).
source.published_check: Tejada-Vera B, Bastian BA, Curtin SC. Deaths: Leading causes for 2023. National Vital Statistics Reports; vol 74 no 10. Hyattsville, MD: National Center for Health Statistics. 2025. doi:10.15620/cdc/174607. Tables 1 and 2.

role: baseline (DESIGN.md decision 1); matches the NVSR 74-06 life tables

definitions.deaths: Deaths of US residents occurring in the 50 states and DC in 2023, classified by underlying cause of death (ICD-10). Records with resident status 4 (foreign residents) are excluded, as in NCHS tabulations.
definitions.cvd_deaths: ICD-10 I00-I99 (all diseases of the circulatory system)
definitions.covid_deaths: ICD-10 U07.1 (COVID-19); extra column beyond DESIGN.md, kept for a sensitivity on shares of non-COVID deaths
definitions.external_deaths: ICD-10 V01-Y89 (external causes of morbidity and mortality: injuries, poisonings, suicides, homicides); extra column for the sensitivity that applies the cohort multiplier to other deaths only
definitions.shares: cause deaths / all-cause deaths in the same cell, 6 decimals
definitions.age_group_start/end: inclusive ages in completed years from NCHS age recode 12; age_group_end is blank for the open-ended 85+ group
definitions.age_not_stated: cause_shares.csv omits deaths with age not stated; cause_shares_all_groups.csv lists them

checks.record_layout: 2023-Mortality-Public-Use-File-Documentation.pdf (pdftotext -layout) gives resident status at 20, sex at 69, age recode 12 at 79-80, data year at 102-105, underlying cause at 146-149
checks.control_total_table_1: 8,116 ICD-10 codes parsed (pdftotext -layout); every row with no suppressed cell satisfies total mentions = underlying + secondary; the printed underlying-cause counts equal the microdata for every code; the 1,801 codes printed '*' have 1 to 9 deaths each in the microdata (5,558 in all; the smallest printed count is 10); printed counts sum to 3,085,406
checks.nvsr74_10_tables_1_2: 45 panels parsed (pdftotext -layout): 'All races, all origins' in Table 1 and 'Infants, all races, all origins' in Table 2; each satisfies ranked causes + all other causes = all causes; published = microdata for 39 all, 36 cancer, 35 stroke, 36 heart, 14 covid comparisons (all-cause by sex for all ages, under 1, 1-4, 5-14, 15-24, 25-34, ..., 85+ and 65+; causes wherever ranked)

notes: Year 2023 matches the NVSR 74-06 (2023) life tables in data/life_tables/. Deaths: Final Data for 2023 (NVSR vol 75 no 8, doi:10.15620/cdc/252471) was not yet online on 2026-09-23 (CDC Stacks lists a 2026-11-12 publication date), so the published-total checks use Deaths: Leading Causes for 2023 (NVSR 74-10) and the 2023 control total table. NCHS also posts 2024 public-use documentation and control totals. CDC WONDER was not queried: its API requires accepting CDC's data-use agreement on the user's behalf. The counts here come from the NCHS public-use microdata and are checked against NCHS's own published totals (see checks). The smallest cause cell in cause_shares.csv has 101 deaths.
